theorems.measure_definition: twoDirac w a u := ENNReal.ofReal (1-w) • Measure.dirac a + ENNReal.ofReal w • Measure.dirac u
theorems.moment_definition: moment μ p := ∫ x : ℝ, x^p ∂μ
theorems.lower_type: For μ : Measure ℝ with IsProbabilityMeasure μ, a.e. x ∈ Icc a b, Integrable x^3, x^4, x^p, moment μ 3=m3, moment μ 4=m4, and ∀ x∈Icc a b, hermite c0 c3 c4 x≤x^p, lower_transport proves c0+c3*m3+c4*m4≤moment μ p.
theorems.upper_type: With the same probability, support, integrability and moment hypotheses and ∀ x∈Icc a b, x^p≤hermite c0 c3 c4 x, upper_transport proves moment μ p≤c0+c3*m3+c4*m4.
theorems.attainment_type: For p : ℕ, 0≤w≤1, (1-w)*a^3+w*u^3=m3, (1-w)*a^4+w*u^4=m4, a^p=hermite c0 c3 c4 a, and u^p=hermite c0 c3 c4 u, twoDirac_attainment proves moment (twoDirac w a u) p=c0+c3*m3+c4*m4.
theorems.composition_result: Each lower/upper wrapper additionally concludes Admissible for its twoDirac measure from stated node membership in Icc a b.
